subject: Mutual Action Plan (initial draft) + timeline options — HRX Health
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@hrxhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (initial draft) + timeline options — HRX Health

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Per our discovery call I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the key milestones, owners, and two timeline options so we can align on a target close date. High-level summary: 

- Milestones included: SSO & SCIM setup, Security review (SOC2 evidence), Pilot integration (sandbox), Pricing & contract sign-off.
- Proposed owners: HRX (procurement + IT), Redwood (AE + Solutions Engineering).
- Timeline options: Option A (aggressive) — 6 weeks to pilot, target close: 2026-05-28; Option B (conservative) — 9 weeks, target close: 2026-06-18.

Ask: could you confirm the list of internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (owners and approvers), and which timeline option you prefer? If procurement/legal need to be included now, please list main contact(s) and any known blackout dates.

Attachments: HRX_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft - milestones & dependencies), discovery-notes-20260414.pdf (call notes).

Quick next steps I propose after you confirm stakeholders and timeline:
1) We schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to walk the plan and assign owners.
2) I’ll share a link to a live MAP in Drive and create a HubSpot task for follow-ups.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/5832 | MAP (Drive folder) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHRX-MAP

If you prefer a short recorded walkthrough instead of a live call, I can send one.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0137

--
Attachment stubs: HRX_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes-20260414.pdf (PDF)
From: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@hrxhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Jenkins <bob.jenkins@hrxhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 17:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (initial draft) + timeline options — HRX Health

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for capturing this so clearly. I reviewed the draft with Bob (ops) and IT — high level notes below and a preferred timeline.

Confirmed stakeholders to include on the MAP:
- Susan Lewis (Product Lead) — susan.lewis@hrxhealth.com
- Bob Jenkins (IT Ops) — bob.jenkins@hrxhealth.com
- Priya Das (Security) — priya.das@hrxhealth.com (will own SOC2 evidence)
- Mark Rivera (Procurement) — mark.rivera@hrxhealth.com (will manage PO & contract)

We prefer Option B (conservative) given our quarter planning and existing project load. That would put our target close around 2026-06-02 — can you update the MAP to reflect that specific date? Procurements at HRX typically require a 3-week review once legal signs off; please flag any contract items that might require additional executive approval.

We do want a short MAP kickoff — Tue 2026-04-21 or Wed 2026-04-22 morning PT works for our team. Can you confirm availability? Also, please add a procurement checklist to the MAP (PO template, approved vendor form).

Thanks,
Susan
VP, Product | HRX Health

Susan —

Perfect, thanks for confirming stakeholders and preferring Option B. I updated the MAP target close to 2026-06-02 and added a procurement checklist placeholder (we'll populate the PO template and approved vendor form once Mark shares his preferred format).

Proposed MAP kickoff: Tue 2026-04-21 at 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes). If that works for you and Bob, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: 1) walk milestones/owners (10 min) 2) procurement & legal touchpoints (10 min) 3) next 14-day actions (10 min).

Marissa — looping you and Dev for the kickoff. Dev, can you own the security review milestone (collect SOC2 artifacts, timeline to complete) and flag any additional items we should surface to Priya? Marissa, if you can draft the initial SOW language for the pilot milestone that would speed contracting.

If Tue morning doesn't work, Wed 4/22 at 9:00 AM PT is my backup.

Thanks — I’ll attach the updated MAP document to the calendar invite once we lock time.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
